messages:
maria: Quick thread — we need a compact launch playbook for the website: launch posts, benchmark narrative, webinar, and inbound form routing that specifically maps to Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Thoughts?

jake: I can take the launch posts cadence and landing copy. Do we want a separate benchmark post that dives into latency/cost numbers?

elsa: Yes. We have clean numbers from the infra run: median token latencies and throughput per mode. I'll pull a short summary and a quote we can use.

ryan: Webinar plan: 30 min total, 20min demo + 10min Q&A or 25/10. Panel: Product (maria), Eng (elsa), Customer (ask Glint?) — show routing and fallback demo.

maria: Good. For messaging on the pages, propose one clear hero + three action flows: Hosted -> quick free API sign-up, Dedicated -> reserved capacity request, Private -> security/compliance contact. Keep hero short and mode-agnostic but add 1-line clarifiers per mode.

olivia: For inbound routing, can we add hidden form fields to capture deployment_mode and interest_tier? That will let SDRs auto-route. Example hidden payload: `{"deployment_mode":"private","interest":"enterprise"}`

jake: Perfect. Suggested form enums: deployment_mode = [hosted,dedicated,private]; interest = [eval,prod,enterprise]; region = [NA,EU,APAC].

elsa: Draft benchmark blurbs (very rough): "Hosted: 85ms median token latency; Dedicated: consistent 12k tokens/s throughput with reserved pools; Private: VPC/HSM-enabled deployments for compliance." We'll tighten the copy.

maria: For launch posts timeline: Teaser (announce webinar + early signups), Benchmarks deep-dive (tech post), Customer story (if we get it), Webinar invite reminder, Launch day recap. Each post should call to the right CTA per mode.

ryan: Panel Qs to prep: routing policy examples, how we maintain latency under burst, fallback behavior across regions, onboarding path for Dedicated. I'll draft 6 questions for the panel.

olivia: Implementation note — form routing: if deployment_mode==private => route to enterprise-queue (team-enterprise@), dedicated => dedicated-sales queue, hosted => automated trial nurture. I'll add mapping to the form builder.

maria: Action items: Jake = draft 3 launch posts + webinar landing copy by Tue; Elsa = benchmark numbers + 2 short engineering quotes; Olivia = wire form fields + routing rules; Ryan = confirm panel + curate Qs; I'll iterate hero/headlines and sample prompt snippets.

maria: Also want small prompt library on each page (2 examples/mode) so devs see immediate playground value. Keep them minimal.

jake: Will post first drafts to #copy-ops and link here. :thumbsup:

mkt-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved Thu 10am PT — calendar invite sent to panelists.
